note: Named inputs for rank_pit_signals. ranker_config is relative to implementation/alpha_signal_pit_ranker; an observations_csv path is relative to the project root. Every input is cut at the call's asof: a row is kept only if its available, decision and target times are all at or before asof.

rank01_market_prices.description: Rank-01 daily price features (momentum 5/21, reversal 5, range position, breakout 63, RSI 14, volatility 21, volume shock 21) over the pitdb Yahoo EOD universe as known at asof (price_asof), target = next-session open-to-close log return. The ranker's own adapter labels these REVISED_VALUE, so results stay PIT_RESEARCH_ONLY.

rank01_market_prices_retained.description: The retained 2026-08-06 Rank-01 observation panel (outputs/market_prices_rank01/normalized_signal_observations.csv), re-ranked on the rows known at asof.
